stories.title: Mohanlal conferred the Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2023
stories.body: announced 20 September (PIB); presented by President Droupadi Murmu at the 71st National Film Awards ceremony on 23 September; the 55th recipient, honoured at 65 (the youngest ever); Padma Shri (2001), Padma Bhushan (2019).

one_liners: Mohanlal conferred the Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2023 — announced 20 September (PIB)
